title: feat(library): add mobile creator flow for readable items (comics/books/magazines)
body:
## Summary
Brings the website's Creator Studio "readable library" (books/comics/magazines) to the Flutter app. Previously the mobile creator "Library" screen only handled **videos** (Upload routed to `/video-upload`), so creators had no way to create comics/books on mobile — the gap the user reported.

This mirrors the web flow in `website/src/app/creator-studio/library/page.tsx` against the already-existing backend creator API (no backend changes).

What's added:
- New service `channel_library_creator_service.dart` wrapping the creator endpoints. Note the backend's mixed casing is handled explicitly:
```
upload-url  → body snake_case  { asset_type, content_type, file_name }
manifest    → body snake_case  { pdf_url | page_image_urls[] }
series/items→ body camelCase   { title, contentType, coverAssetUrl, ... }
```
  Signed-URL → GCS PUT reuses `BroadcastService.uploadToGcs`.
- `creator_library_management_screen.dart` now has a **Watch / Readables** tab toggle. *Watch* is the unchanged existing video list; *Readables* lists library items (cover, title, content-type, draft/published status chip) with an "Add Readable" button.
- New `readable_upload_screen.dart`: title/author/description, content type, optional series (select or create inline), cover upload, content upload as **either a PDF or multiple page images** → calls the manifest generator (auto-fills total pages) → **Save Draft** or **Publish** (publish requires title + author + generated manifest, matching the web validation). Publish creates the item with `status: 'published'` directly, same as the web's create-and-publish path.
- Route registered in `main.dart`.

Scope: additive only — the viewer reader, player, PiP, and video-upload flows are untouched.

Verification: `flutter analyze` on all new/changed files — `No issues found!`. End-to-end create/publish still needs an on-device run against the backend (needs a creator login + exclusive channel).

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/ab26e739ebb9486d825b99be1ebbed04
